title: Fairly heavy rainfall expected in parts of the island today
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at most places of the island after 1.00 pm, today (20), the Department of Meteorology said.

title: In 45-minute phone call with Pezeshkian, PM Shehbaz reaffirms Pakistan’s commitment to advancing regional peace
byline: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif held a telephone call with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian on Sunday, reaffirming during the conversation that Pakistan would ‘‘remain fully committed to its honest and sincere efforts to advance regional peace and security."

title: Second school term for 2026 begins today
byline: The second school term for the year 2026 in all government and government-approved private Sinhala and Tamil schools commences today (20).

title: US seizes Iranian cargo ship, Tehran vows to retaliate
byline: The United States said on Sunday that it had seized an Iranian cargo ship that tried to run its blockade and Iran said it would retaliate, raising the possibility that the ceasefire between the two countries might not last for even the two days it is set to remain in force.

title: Iranian state media suggest new talks won’t take place
byline: There has been no comment from Iranian officials on U.S. President Donald Trump’s announcement of new talks in Pakistan this week.

title: Chinese national arrested with cigarettes at BIA
byline: A foreign national has been arrested by airport customs officers earlier this morning (20) for illegally bringing a large consignment of China- manufactured cigarettes into the country.

title: Oil prices jump as Strait of Hormuz standoff escalates
byline: Crude oil prices rose in early trading Sunday.

title: Two Indonesian nationals arrested with over 5kg of ‘Kush’ at BIA
byline: Two foreign nationals have been arrested earlier this morning (20) by officers of the Airport Police Narcotics Bureau (PNB) while attempting to leave the country with a stock of ‘Kush’ narcotics through the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) in Katunayake.

title: Over 80 killed in road accidents, drowning incidents during New Year period - Police
byline: More than 80 persons have lost their lives due to road accidents and drowning incidents during the New Year season, according to police.

title: Two suspects arrested over drug trafficking links
byline: Two individuals have been arrested by police in the Kottawa and Homagama areas in connection with drug trafficking offenses.

title: Public services of Dept. for Registration of Persons resume today
byline: The Department for Registration of Persons has announced that the issuance of National Identity Cards (NICs), which had been temporarily suspended, will resume from today (20).

title: Mahinda Rajapaksa says ‘grand plan’ in place to regain political power in New Year
byline: Former President Mahinda Rajapaksa has stated that a significant plan is in place to regain political power in the New Year.

title: Measures introduced to regulate tourist boat services at Gregory Lake
byline: The Mayor of the Nuwara Eliya Municipal Council, Upali Wanigasekera, has announced that steps will be taken to regulate tourist boat services at Gregory Lake under strict safety guidelines.

title: Advisory issued for severe lightning across all provinces
byline: An ‘Amber’ advisory has been issued by the Department of Meteorology for severe lightning across all provinces of Sri Lanka.

title: Three injured in motorcycle collision on Neluwa–Morawaka road
byline: Three individuals have been injured and hospitalized in a motorcycle accident that had occurred this morning (20) along the Neluwa-Morawaka road.

title: PHIs take legal action against over 1,200 shops after raids during festive season
byline: Public Health Inspectors (PHIs) across Sri Lanka have conducted inspections at 21,796 business establishments island wide targeting the festive season, according to the Public Health Inspectors’ Union (PHIU).

title: Makumbura MMC serves over 150,000 passengers during festive period
byline: It is reported that more than 150,000 passengers have utilized the services of the Makumbura Multimodal Centre (MMC) during the festive season.

title: Iran executes two men accused of involvement in ‘spy network linked to Israel’
byline: Iran executed two men convicted of cooperating with Israel’s Mossad intelligence service and planning attacks inside the country, the judiciary’s news outlet Mizan reported on ⁠Sunday.

title: Gold prices rise in Sri Lanka; 24-carat exceeds Rs. 400,000
byline: In line with global market trends, gold prices in Sri Lanka have increased by around Rs. 2000, according to local market data.

title: Skilled workforce essential to strengthen primary healthcare – Health Minister
byline: The Minister of Health and Mass Media, Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa emphasized that the service of skilled and dedicated health professionals is essential for achieving future targets in the healthcare sector.

title: Commissioner General of Motor Traffic granted bail
byline: The Commissioner General of Motor Traffic, Kamal Amarasinghe, who was arrested by the Criminal Investigation Department (CID), has been granted bail by the Pilessa Magistrate’s Court in Kurunegala.

title: Indian Vice President visits Nuwara Eliya
byline: India’s Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan has undertaken a visit to Nuwara Eliya this morning (20).

title: Fairly heavy rainfall over to 75 mm expected in several provinces – Met. Dept
byline: The Department of Meteorology has announced that fairly heavy rainfall between 75 mm and 100 mm is expected today (April 20) in certain areas of the Central, Sabaragamuwa, Western, North-Central, and Southern provinces.

title: 98 individuals arrested on open warrants in special island-wide raids
byline: Sri Lanka Police stated that a total of 98 individuals with open warrants were arrested during special island-wide crime prevention and anti-narcotics operations.

title: VP Radhakrishnan reaffirms India’s commitment to welfare of Tamil people in Sri Lanka
byline: The Vice President of India, CP Radhakrishnan, today (20) visited houses built with the assistance of the Government of India under the Indian Housing Project (Phase III) at the Liddlesdale Estate, Ragala, Nuwara Eliya, and interacted with the beneficiaries.

title: Former Minister Piyasena Gamage granted bail
byline: The Colombo Magistrate’s Court has ordered the release of former Minister Piyasena Gamage on bail, following his arrest by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption over allegations of corruption (CIABOC).

title: Six envoys present credentials to President
byline: Two High Commissioners, three Ambassadors and the Apostolic Nuncio-designate of the Holy See presented their credentials to President Anura Kumara Dissanayake at the Presidential Secretariat today (20).

title: First tsunami waves reach Japan’s eastern coast
byline: Local media is now reporting that the first tsunami waves are reaching Iwate prefecture, with one wave as high as 40cm recorded in Miyako port.

title: Warm weather advisory issued for several provinces
byline: A warm weather advisory has been issued for residents of the Northern, North-Western, North-Central, Western, Sabaragamuwa, Eastern and Southern provinces and the Monaragala district.

title: Road accidents rise sharply during festive period, police reveal
byline: A surge in road traffic accidents has been recorded between April 10 and 19 this year compared to the same period last year, according to Deputy Inspector General of Police in charge of Traffic Control and Road Safety, W. P. J. Senadeera.

title: No plans to attend second round of talks with US - Iranian spokesman
byline: Iran has not yet decided whether it will attend a second round of negotiations with the US, a spokesman for Iran’s foreign ministry says.

title: Another 19 Indian fishermen to be repatriated from Sri Lanka
byline: A total of 19 Indian fishermen, who were detained by the Sri Lanka Navy, are scheduled to be repatriated from Sri Lanka this evening (20), marking the latest batch of releases amid sustained diplomatic efforts between the two countries.

title: Tsunami warning issued after 7.4-magnitude earthquake hits off Japan
byline: An earthquake with a preliminary magnitude of 7.4 struck off the northeastern coast of Japan on Monday (Apr 20) afternoon, the Japan Meteorological Agency said.

title: Three injured after three-wheeler falls into 50-foot precipice in Watawala
byline: A three-wheeler carrying members of the same family veered off the road and fell down a precipice of about 50 feet, injuring three of the passengers. They have been admitted to the Watawala Regional Hospital.

title: At least 25 killed in firecracker factory blast in India
byline: At least 25 people have been killed in an explosion at a firecracker factory in the southern Indian state of Tamil Nadu, with four others seriously injured.

title: Indian Vice President concludes official visit to Sri Lanka
byline: The Vice President of India, C. P. Radhakrishnan concluded his two-day visit to Sri Lanka this afternoon (20).

title: Sri Lanka’s tourist arrivals in 2026 surpass 800,000
byline: The number of tourist arrivals in Sri Lanka in 2026 has crossed the 800,000-mark, the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority (SLTDA) stated.

title: Excise revenue surpasses first quarter target
byline: The Excise Department of Sri Lanka has reported a record performance in revenue collection during the first quarter of 2026, exceeding its projected target and registering notable year-on-year growth.

title: Alert for potential mega-quake in Japan issued, tsunami warnings still in effect
byline: The Japan Meteorological Agency has issued an alert for a potential mega-quake, following the magnitude 7.7 quake on Monday. The agency says residents in seven prefectures should prepare for disaster and listen for any updates.

title: Iran’s President says war must end to focus on rebuilding
byline: Iran needs to end the war against the United States and Israel as swiftly as possible to focus on the bigger task of reconstruction, according to President Masoud Pezeshkian.

title: New NIE Director General assumes duties
byline: Senior Professor OG Dayaratna Banda has assumed duties as the 15th Director General of the National Institute of Education (NIE) Maharagama, with effect from today (April 20).

title: Central Bank presents Annual Economic Review and Financial Statements and Operations reports to President
byline: The “Annual Economic Review 2025” and “Financial Statements and Operations 2025” reports of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka have been presented to the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake, at the Presidential Secretariat today (20).

title: Netanyahu condemns Israeli soldier who attacked statue of Jesus Christ
byline: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has condemned “in the strongest terms” the damaging of a “Catholic religious icon” by an Israeli soldier in southern Lebanon.

title: Special traffic plan in place tomorrow near Kochchikade Church
byline: A special traffic plan will be in effect tomorrow (April 21) in and around the St. Anthony’s Church in Kochchikade, in view of a special religious service, police stated.

title: Donald Trump ‘to consider lifting blockade in Strait of Hormuz’ to break deadlock in peace talks
byline: US President Donald Trump will consider lifting an American naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz to enable peace talks with Iran in Islamabad, according to reports.

title: UNP denies circulating social media statement on May Day celebrations
byline: The United National Party (UNP) has dismissed as false a statement currently circulating on social media under the title “UNP’s stance on celebrating International Workers’ Day,” which uses the party’s official logo.

title: Anura Karunathilaka sworn in as new Energy Minister
byline: Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation Anura Karunathilake has been appointed as the Minister of Energy.

title: WHO team reviews Sri Lanka’s health system reform program
byline: A World Health Organization (WHO) expert team has arrived in Sri Lanka to review the progress of the country’s health system and submit recommendations to strengthen it further, the Ministry of Health said in a statement.

title: Trump tariff refunds begin after Supreme Court order
byline: The Trump administration has begun processing refunds for billions of dollars in tariffs that the US Supreme Court struck down in February.

title: CBSL presents Annual Economic Review and Financial Statements and Operations reports to President
byline: The “Annual Economic Review 2025” and “Financial Statements and Operations 2025” reports of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka have been presented to the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake, at the Presidential Secretariat today (20).

title: Lebanon, Israel to hold second round of talks in Washington on Thursday
byline: A second meeting between Lebanon and Israel will take place in Washington on Thursday, with official details to be announced later, a senior Lebanese official said on Monday.

title: Govt. aims to transform schools into safe, caring spaces for children: PM Harini
byline: The Prime Minister and the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, Dr. Harini Amarasuriya, today (20) affirmed that the government’s goal is to transform schools into safe and trustworthy environments where children receive love and care.
